case.title: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG. Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings. Need: 8150 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 45 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200001. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70110.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
sup:70110.subject: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
sup:70110.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. For many years, our family foundry has taken great pride in supplying your respected company with high-quality castings from our region, and we value our long standing relationship very much.

Our team has prepared our offer carefully. We can offer you a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

To remain transparent about our situation, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. We trust that you understand the necessity of these figures for our ongoing operation and quality standards.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

message.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
message.body:
Dear Mr Brandlhuber,

Thank you for your offer and for setting out your cost situation so openly. We share your pride in the many years of reliable cooperation between our two family companies, and we take the cost pressure you describe seriously.

At the same time, we cannot accept the increase as proposed. We have worked out a fair counterproposal and would like to give you a genuine choice:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 126.89; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 60 days net.
Option B: unit price EUR 123.18; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 45 days net.
Option C: unit price EUR 125.46; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 30 days net.

Each option balances price, timing and payment differently, so you can pick the one that best suits your foundry. We look forward to your view.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
message.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
message.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We appreciate your counterproposal and your commitment to our long-standing partnership. However, the prices suggested in your options are not feasible for our foundry given the raw material pressures we face. 

Our current offer stands at a price of €140.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. 

As a fair compromise, we offer to delay the effective date to 2027-01-01 and reduce our price to EUR 136.20, keeping our standard 30-day payment terms. This alternative package is a price of €136.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 January 2027. 

Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our traditional cooperation.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

message.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
message.body:
Dear Mr Brandlhuber,

Thank you for your revised offer and for moving towards us. We understand that raw material costs weigh on your foundry, and we respect that our earlier figures did not work for you.

We have reconsidered carefully and moved as well. While we cannot bring the effective date forward, Option C keeps your standard payment terms, and Option A offers a higher price in return for a longer payment term.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 128.57; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 60 days net.
Option B: unit price EUR 124.81; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 45 days net.
Option C: unit price EUR 127.13; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 30 days net.

We believe one of these is a fair solution for both our family companies, and we look forward to continuing our good cooperation.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
message.body:
Guten Tag,

We appreciate your revised offer and your understanding of the raw material costs weighing on our foundry. Over the many years of our partnership, we have always valued open and honest cooperation between our companies. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We are willing to accept the effective date of 2027-04-01 with our standard 30-day payment terms, provided the price reflects our reality. Therefore, we propose a price of EUR 138.80 per unit for this package. Our offer is a price of €138.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. This offer remains valid for 30 days. 

Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. We trust that this adjusted Angebot provides a fair path forward for both of our businesses, and we look forward to continuing our long-standing relationship.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

We appreciate your continued movement and your commitment to finding a fair solution for both our family companies. Over the many years of our partnership, we have always valued working closely with your respected firm. In response, we are taking another step towards you and can offer a price of €137.90 per unit, keeping the 30-day payment terms and the April start date.

Thomas Brandlhuber
